# Ilse

> The designer's eye inside the code agent. Point at what's wrong in the running app in the browser; your own coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor CLI, Gemini CLI) fixes it in the code — or Ilse applies it itself when no AI is needed. Local only, no API keys of its own. MIT.

## Use it

- Install and run, in a React project with its dev server running: `npx github:idantas/ilse` (opens the app at http://localhost:4700 with the toolbar)
- [README](README.md): setup, how it works, the cost ladder, usage limits, CLI, MCP

## Work on it

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): commands, rules, code map, recipes, definition of done — start here
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): issues and pull requests
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): reporting vulnerabilities, what Ilse guarantees
- [Architecture diagram](.github/assets/ilse-architecture.svg)
